items.text: Goal-setting skills mean turning a vague wish into a clear outcome, breaking it into steps you can act on, reviewing progress honestly and adjusting when facts change, and the habit shows in results you can describe rather than in a list of ambitions.
Write one outcome, define the next three actions, review on a fixed day and adjust without drama.
Treat targets as plans to test and review them against facts.
